title: Independent N1-N5 development expansion: 50 original sentences
status: Development-visible proposal. It is adopted only after this source PR passes all seven exact-head hosted checks, an uninvolved checker accepts it, and the PR is merged. Until then, do not measure rules with these rows.

provenance.japanese_sentence_provenance: Original Japanese sentences composed with AI assistance for this development bank. No exam, textbook, game, dictionary or corpus sentence text was copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: Provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese references and variants. Independent agent cross-review corrections were applied before this freeze. They are candidate references, not model gold or human-reviewed translations.
provenance.level_note: N1 through N5 are approximate planning labels for individual sentences. They are not official JLPT items or certified difficulty labels.

review_and_adoption.process: Use a separate data-only source PR. The owner/controller selects an uninvolved Codex checker by task difficulty (Terra or Luna). The author does not accept their own work. Adopt this bank only after all seven exact-head hosted checks pass, the checker accepts the source PR, and the PR is merged. Do not measure a corresponding rule before those conditions. Independent agent review is not human review.
review_and_adoption.measurement: These 50 rows are supplemental and development-visible. The current challenge runner does not load this JSON. No score or pass rate is claimed here. Keep the historical challenge, baseline, ratchet and held-out isolation unchanged.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: Ten sentences per approximate level and 25 paired controls are limited probes. They do not prove full N1-N5 translation quality. Human calibration and broader stratified review remain open.
